background.description: White paper, left thumb impression in black or blue ink

notes: Verified against the official CRP PO/MT-XVI notification (Annexure III): left thumb impression on white paper in black or blue ink, 240x240 pixels at 200 DPI (i.e. 3cm x 3cm), 20-50 KB, JPEG. If you don't have a left thumb, IBPS's own fallback order is: right thumb, then other left-hand fingers starting from the forefinger, then right-hand fingers, then left toe — note which one you used directly in the uploaded image as IBPS instructs.
